trigger_cases.prompt: Design the first-time user onboarding flow for our consumer app.
Audit and eliminate drop-off in our FTUX welcome wizard.
Redesign empty states and interactive checklists for new users.
Apply the bowling alley framework to shorten time-to-value.
Build a zero-to-hello-world onboarding experience for our developer SDK.
Write database migration scripts for user accounts.
Implement a Stripe payment webhook handler.

binary_cases.prompt: Specify the welcome experience for first-time app users.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Eliminate frontloaded modal carousels and use contextual just-in-time guidance or actionable empty states.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Deliver contextual just-in-time guidance and an actionable empty state that encourages learning by doing instead of modal tours.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Show a 5-step carousel modal explaining the whole UI before users can enter.

binary_cases.prompt: Optimize user onboarding to reach the Aha! moment faster.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Implement straight-line onboarding by pruning non-essential steps and providing sensible defaults.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Adopt straight-line onboarding to guide the user to the Aha! moment on the shortest path by using sensible defaults and pruning extraneous setup questions.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Force a mandatory profile survey and a 10-step wizard before showing any product output.

binary_cases.prompt: Define user dismissal and skip behavior during onboarding.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Make onboarding always skippable with clear exit controls and persistent resumption in the UI.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Ensure the flow is skippable at all times with a prominent dismiss action and allow users to resume later from a persistent checklist.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Create an unskippable tutorial and trap user until all tasks are finished.
